validatedBehavior: Public peer-native exec drives a native Rust MCP fixture with PATH=/nonexistent; no Node/Bun engine sidecar.

Actual stdio SDK initialization and repeated tools/call reuse one managed connection; JSON and SSE Streamable HTTP and separate legacy GET endpoint/SSE POST all return paired structured Tool Result/Evidence.
One actual PTY approval permits one call; the next call requires a fresh decision and a denial sends no tools/call. Non-TTY Ask denies before transport startup.
Registry/config revision drift and policy revocation during blocked initialize invalidate the original grant before tools/call; definite not-dispatched facts use canonical receipts.

SDK business isError, JSON-RPC errors, disconnect, oversize frame, oversize normalized result, real 30-second timeout and SIGTERM retain distinct actual outcomes; sent uncertain calls are never retried.

Configured header/env echoes are redacted before persistence; one-pass matching cannot recursively expand replacement text. Redaction cannot change the independently preserved protocol failure outcome.

After a real parent hard exit, complete original recorder and process-group observations settle only local pumps/owned children. Remote effect remains unfenced_external and canonical uncertain dispatch stays present.
Repeated recover does not duplicate known billing or replay a model/tool. A distinct independently scoped worktree accepts a later task without erasing the prior unknown.
Future handle metadata is preserved byte-for-value and blocks recovery; restoring the original known synthetic identity allows real managed cleanup while retaining external unknown.
Current TS cold-read preserves exact MCP result/Evidence records; real TS Work save then native re-read preserves canonical pending/receipt/usage facts.
